steps: Consumer receives an event with stable ID E.
Transaction attempts to insert E into a uniquely constrained table.
First insert commits together with the business effect.
Replay hits the existing row and skips the effect safely.

lesson.scenario: An email consumer handles at-least-once order events while sending one receipt per event identity.

steps.title: Deliver the first event
steps.narration: The broker delivers order.paid event evt-771 for order O-90017 with payload checksum sha256:4aa1.

dedup.detail: No work accepted in this phase

email.detail: No work accepted in this phase

outbox.detail: No work accepted in this phase

steps.outcome: The consumer has a stable producer-assigned identity.
steps.invariant: The deduplication claim and durable side-effect intent commit atomically, with uniqueness scoped to consumer and stable event ID.

steps.title: Claim with a unique insert
steps.narration: The unique primary key (consumer_name,event_id) succeeds and records processing plus checksum 4aa1.

email.detail: No work accepted in this phase

outbox.detail: No work accepted in this phase

steps.invariant: The deduplication claim and durable side-effect intent commit atomically, with uniqueness scoped to consumer and stable event ID.

steps.title: Commit intent with completion
steps.narration: One database transaction inserts outbox row mail-882 and marks dedup row completed.

email.detail: No work accepted in this phase

steps.outcome: A crash cannot lose the send intent after marking complete.
steps.invariant: The deduplication claim and durable side-effect intent commit atomically, with uniqueness scoped to consumer and stable event ID.

steps.title: Send with stable identity
steps.narration: The dispatcher sends the receipt and the provider records message em-992 under event key evt-771.
steps.outcome: Provider retries also collapse to one email.
steps.invariant: The deduplication claim and durable side-effect intent commit atomically, with uniqueness scoped to consumer and stable event ID.

steps.title: Discard duplicate delivery
steps.narration: The second unique insert conflicts; checksum matches, so the consumer acknowledges offset 991 without recreating the outbox row.
steps.outcome: Duplicate delivery has no duplicate business effect.
steps.invariant: The deduplication claim and durable side-effect intent commit atomically, with uniqueness scoped to consumer and stable event ID.
